title: Necklace Of The Mystic Mirror
description: The <keyword>Necklace of the Mystic Mirror</keyword> boosts your <property>Arcane Resonance</property> by 100%, <positive>amplifying every effect</positive> that triggers on collecting a <warning>Spirit</warning> - like health regen from the <keyword>Ring of Curative Talent</keyword> or Soul Ward/mana recovery from the <keyword>Ring of Manaweaving</keyword>.

<keyword>Necklace of the Mystic Mirror</keyword> увеличивает <property>Arcane Resonance</property> на 100%, <positive>усиливая все эффекты</positive>, которые срабатывают при сборе <warning>духа</warning> - например, лечение от <keyword>Ring of Curative Talent</keyword> или восстановление Soul Ward/маны от <keyword>Ring of Manaweaving</keyword>.
